### Acceptance criteria

- Plan reference: .spec/plan/M2-booking-payments.md task BE-M2-07. Contract: .spec/contracts/payments.md 3.4 (and open question P2), .spec/contracts/booking.md section 5 (AssignmentFailed). Read decisions Q04, Q10, Q15, G-2, principle 0 (customer money is protected first).
- DECISION RECORD (approval relayed by M2 from the leader's private messages on 2026-10-10, NOT written by the leader on GitHub; the leader is asked to confirm in a comment here): P2 = the recommended default, i.e. a schema change SC-10 on PAYMENT_TRANSACTION: `refunded_amount DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`, `refund_reason NVARCHAR(255) NULL`, `refunded_at DATETIME2 NULL`; `txn_status = REFUNDED` once `refunded_amount > 0`; a refund is refused when it would exceed `amount`. Also approved as recommended (recorded in decisions.md here, implemented by later tickets): B4, B5, B11, P4. Schema is normally M1's: the entity, its configuration and ONE new migration are in this ticket's allowed paths on the leader's relayed approval.
- Schema: add the three columns to the entity PaymentTransaction.cs and its configuration, ONE new EF migration (up and down) with the updated model snapshot, generated with `dotnet ef migrations add`; nothing else in the model changes; decisions.md section 3 gets SC-10.
- Real IRefundService (payments.md 3.4), registered by PaymentsModule so it replaces FakeRefundService: refunds against the order's SUCCESS (or already partially REFUNDED) ORDER transaction through IPaymentGateway.RefundAsync; amount whole VND (Vnd.Round), > 0 and <= amount minus refunded_amount, else RefundResult.Succeeded = false and nothing changes; unknown order or no refundable transaction -> Succeeded = false.
- Money safety (no double refund): the refund is reserved in the database with a conditional update (refunded_amount + amount <= amount, status SUCCESS or REFUNDED) BEFORE the gateway call; if the gateway fails the reservation is reverted exactly (status back to SUCCESS when refunded_amount returns to 0), nothing stays recorded, Succeeded = false. A gateway without a refund API (GatewaySupported = false) records the refund in the DB only; the PR states which path was used.
- After a recorded refund: publish OrderRefunded { OrderId, CustomerId, Amount, Reason, RefundedAtUtc } and push a payment.status notification (txnStatus REFUNDED); refund_reason is stored truncated to 255 characters.
- Booking handles AssignmentFailed { OrderId, Reason, FailedAtUtc } (booking.md section 5): order PAID / DISPATCHING / ASSIGNED -> CANCELLED with cancel_reason = Reason (truncated to 255), OrderCancelled published after the commit, then a 100 % refund of the order's paid amount through IRefundService. Idempotent: an order already CANCELLED changes nothing and is not refunded twice; unknown order is ignored. If the refund fails the failure is logged as an error (a retry mechanism is NOT part of this ticket and is named in the PR).
- Not in this ticket: Premium hold release (Scope exception #257), extension refund on ExtensionDeclined (BE-M2-08), customer cancel (BE-M2-09), P4 late-payment refund and B4 PAID -> DISPATCHING (follow-up ticket).
- No new package, endpoint or port change (AGENTS.md rule 5); no OpenAPI change.
- Tests in Backend/Tests/Payments and Backend/Tests/Booking: full refund; partial 60 % then a second partial; refund above the remaining amount refused; zero / negative / non-whole amount; unknown order; no SUCCESS transaction; gateway failure reverts the reservation; DB-only path when the gateway has no refund API; concurrent identical refunds cannot exceed the amount; OrderRefunded published once with the right fields; AssignmentFailed cancels + refunds 100 %, and a second AssignmentFailed does nothing. DB-backed ones skip when SQL Server is unavailable.
- Verification: the harness verify L3 passes; paste the last line and log path in the PR. Tick BE-M2-07 in .spec/plan/M2-booking-payments.md with evidence in the same PR.
